title: Four Verbs of the Mind
label: ch:hi-verbs-of-the-mind
canDo: I can say what I think, understand, read and write in Hindi, run all four through the present habitual, and say "Sorry, I don't understand" when I need to.

payoff.summary: Run सोचना, समझना, पढ़ना and लिखना through मैं …ता/ती हूँ, spell out मेरा नाम from the letters you first wrote by hand, and name the one meaning — to scratch — that four unrelated families each chose for "write".
